final_rationale: The pinned extract and executable audit support descriptive characterisation of the delivered annual/seasonal-crop mapped units only. Threshold sensitivity, sparse confidence coverage, absent Türkiye ground truth, cross-layer offsets and conditional HGM redistribution prohibit completeness, change or operational claims.

intended_use.decision_context: Low-stakes, reversible characterisation of distributed model outputs; do not make operational, legal, subsidy, insurance or enforcement decisions
mandatory_requirements: explicit target ontology and use restrictions
threshold, topology, confidence and cross-layer sensitivity evidence
prohibited_inferences: complete agricultural area or omission rate
high-consequence decisions without independent local validation
intended_use.use_statement: Pre-validation descriptive product audit and research prioritisation for the Türkiye extract

product.name: Fields of The World Türkiye nominal 2024/2025 seasonal/annual-crop mapped-unit predictions

restrictions: Characterise the pinned distributed output only; do not infer ground accuracy or completeness
Report all area-floor and topology scenarios; do not treat absolute count or median as threshold-invariant
Apply confidence thresholds only within the documented non-null coverage subset
Do not infer agricultural change, cadastral status, registry status or rights-affecting eligibility
Do not redistribute HGM-dependent material through a commercial publisher until written rights clearance

stages.acceptance_criterion: Use is reversible and explicitly excludes high-consequence decisions without local validation
stages.evidence_required: Named decision, affected users, error costs, and acceptable residual uncertainty
stages.notes: Proceed with due diligence; retain all use restrictions

stages.observed_evidence: Raw SHA-256 423c5e780d26c2bfc0a1c84bcf9b68029452be8a0e524a4395fde9c5d745774d; Türkiye absent from 24 evaluation countries; perennial/tree crops, pasture, and orchards excluded by target ontology

stages.notes: Use provider area and perimeter for aggregate shape summaries
stages.observed_evidence: Maximum median-ratio deviation 2.38e-09; 3,552,813 retained polygons contain interior rings

stages.acceptance_criterion: Headline distribution levels remain within declared tolerances and summed area is distinguished from exact unique mapped surface
stages.evidence_required: 0/50/100/200/400/800 m2 sensitivity, exact duplicates, outlier bands/caps, province-rank cap sensitivity, exhaustive tiled national union, and selected-cell near-duplicate screen

stages.acceptance_criterion: A national confidence filter is allowed only if coverage is representative and null semantics are resolved
